events.body:
## Context

README describes `.github/workflows/test-data-display.yml` and a Wrangler CI job that were removed; says `cd BLT-Leaf`; and the migrations list stops at 0003 although `migrations/0004_add_etag_column.sql` exists.

## What to do

1. Replace the CI section with `scripts/ci/test.sh blt-leaf` / `npm test`.
2. Use `cd BLT/blt-leaf` and add 0004 to the tree.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No references to the deleted workflow
- [ ] Setup works from the monorepo root

## How to test locally

```bash
npm test
```

---
